spf.headline: SPF {{spf}}

reason.extreme: UV is very high ({{uv}}). Apply generously after your moisturizer.
reason.high: UV is high ({{uv}}). Apply it as the last step of your morning routine.
reason.moderate: UV is moderate ({{uv}}). Apply it as the last step every day.
reason.low: UV is low, but most rays pass through clouds. Use it every day.

spf.refreshWindow: UV peaks {{start}}–{{end}}; reapply every 2 hours if you're outside.
spf.refreshAny: Reapply every 2 hours if you're outside.

reason.intense: The air is very dry (humidity {{humidity}}%). Use a serum and a ceramide cream together.
reason.barrier: It's very cold ({{temperature}}°C). A cream with ceramides and cholesterol protects your barrier.
reason.boost: Humidity is low ({{humidity}}%). Layer a serum under your moisturizer.
reason.light: Humidity is high ({{humidity}}%). Choose a water-based gel over a heavy cream.
reason.light_hot: It's very hot ({{temperature}}°C). Skip heavy products and carry thermal water.
reason.standard: Humidity is balanced ({{humidity}}%); your usual moisturizer is enough.

moisture.nightMask: Add an occlusive hydrating mask tonight.

reason.cold: It's {{temperature}}°C; cold dries lips quickly. Reapply during the day.
reason.dry: Humidity is {{humidity}}%. Dry air cracks lips quickly; reapply during the day.
reason.both: Cold and dry air ({{temperature}}°C, humidity {{humidity}}%). Protect your lips often.
reason.none: Today's weather is easy on your lips.

mobileAuth.strengthHint: At least 6 characters. Mix letters, numbers and symbols.
mobileAuth.trust: Your data is protected under KVKK.
mobileAuth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a reset link.
mobileAuth.forgotSent: If this address is registered, we sent a reset link. Tap it and the app opens so you can set a new password. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
mobileAuth.resetSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
mobileAuth.signupSent: You are registered. Check your spam folder if the email does not arrive.
mobileAuth.resendSent: We sent a new email. Use only the newest email's code; older ones stop working. Check your spam folder too.
mobileAuth.verifyHint: Type the code or tap the button in the email. If you confirmed with the button, continue below.
mobileAuth.errCodeInvalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Make sure you typed the code from the latest email; if it still fails, resend it.
mobileAuth.errInvalidCredentials: Email or password is incorrect. Please check and try again.
mobileAuth.errEmailNotConfirmed: This email is not confirmed yet. Enter the code from your email or tap its confirm button; resend it if it did not arrive.
mobileAuth.errAlreadyRegistered: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in; if you forgot your password, tap "Forgot password?".
mobileAuth.errWeakPassword: This password is too weak. Choose a longer one that mixes letters, numbers and symbols.
mobileAuth.errSamePassword: The new password must be different from the old one.
mobileAuth.errRateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute or two and try again; if it continues, turn off any VPN / corporate network.
mobileAuth.errEmailSend: The email could not be sent right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
mobileAuth.errLinkInvalid: The link is invalid or has expired. Email apps can open links in advance, so your account may already be confirmed: try signing in first. If not, resend the confirmation email. If you are resetting your password, request a new link.
mobileAuth.errNetwork: Could not reach the server. Make sure your internet / VPN connection is on, then try again.

intro.title: Let’s get to know you.
intro.lead: I need to know a few things so I can build your routine around you.
intro.easy: One question per screen. Skip what you don’t know and change it later.
intro.private: Your answers are only used to personalize your routine.

basics.title: First, about you
basics.subtitle: Rebi will call you by your name.
basics.ageRange: Rebi is made for ages {{min}}–{{max}}. Could you check your age?

gender.title: Your gender?
gender.subtitle: Hormones affect skin; we shape the routine around that.

hormonal.title: How are your hormones?
hormonal.subtitle: Your cycle changes how your skin behaves from week to week.

period.title: When did your last period start?
period.subtitle: Knowing where you are in your cycle lets us adjust the routine.

skinType.title: What is your skin type?
skinType.subtitle: If you are not sure, pick "Normal"; Rebi works it out from your other answers.
skinType.guide: How do I tell my skin type?

concerns.subtitle: You can pick more than one.

primary.title: Where should we start?

flags.title: A little more detail
flags.subtitle: Pick what fits you; continue if none do.

life.title: Water and sleep
life.subtitle: Pick a value close to your daily average.

stress.caption: Stress test · {{n}}/{{total}}

smoking.title: Do you smoke?
smoking.subtitle: We ask because it affects skin repair.

alcohol.title: Do you drink alcohol?
alcohol.subtitle: We ask because it affects skin hydration.

makeup.title: Do you wear makeup?
makeup.subtitle: How you cleanse shapes your routine.

actives.title: Have you used strong actives?
actives.subtitle: Like retinol, AHA/BHA or high-strength vitamin C.

tolerance.title: How did your skin react to each?
tolerance.subtitle: Anything you leave alone counts as "No issues". We never put ingredients you reacted badly to in your routine.
tolerance.sheet: Pick how it went with this ingredient.

photo.title: Would you like to add a photo?
photo.subtitle: It helps a lot to compare your progress over time. You can add one later too.

photo.stored: Your photo is kept private, in a secure area only you can access.

mobileShelf.subtitle: Products you've finished wait here until you restock.
mobileShelf.emptyBody: When a product runs out, mark it with "Product finished" on Today. It shows faded in your routine and doesn't count toward your progress until you restock.
mobileShelf.alternativePrompt: I've run out of "{{product}}". What can I use instead? Can you suggest alternatives that suit my skin and routine?
mobileShelf.hint: Products marked finished show faded in your routine and don't count toward your steps. Tap "Restocked" once you have a new one.
mobileShelf.loadFailed: Couldn't load your shelf. Check your connection.

mobileRoutine.askPrompt: Why am I using "{{item}}" in my routine and how should I apply it? Can you also suggest alternatives that suit my skin?
mobileRoutine.comboHint: You don't need everything in one product: treat this line as example target ingredients; if you can't find them all together, pick one of the similar ones.

water.title: Water
water.body: Drink at least 2 L a day. It directly affects your skin's hydration.

sleep.title: Sleep
sleep.body: Aim for 7–8 hours. Your skin repairs itself at night.

mobileLocation.promptTitle: Show the weather for where you are
mobileLocation.promptBody: Sunscreen, moisturizer and lip balm advice follows the real weather at your location. Your location is only used approximately (~1 km).
